Implement the plugin entry point and register debim tools under the IngeTrazo Extensions menu and toolbar.

1. Create `debim_ingetrazo/plugin.py` subclassing IngeTrazo's base Tool class.
2. Register menu entries under `Extensions > debim`:
   - `Import .debim Manifest...`
   - `Toggle Live Sync`

next_issue.label: jules

next_issue.title: feat(core): pure-python .debim parser and 3D entity geometry builder
next_issue.body:
### Overview
Implement declarative manifest parsing and convert .debim entities into native IngeTrazo 3D geometry.

### Tasks
1. Implement lightweight YAML/debim parser (`debim_ingetrazo/parser.py`) with zero heavy dependencies.
2. Build entity converters (`debim_ingetrazo/builder.py`):
   - `storeys` -> Hierarchical Groups
   - `slabs` -> Solid Face Extrusions (`S-SLAB` tag)
   - `walls` -> Extruded Wall Volumes with openings (`A-WALL` tag)
   - `columns` -> Reusable Component Instances (`S-COLS` tag)
3. Preserve dimensional accuracy and coordinate offsets.
next_issue.label: jules

next_issue.title: feat(agent): Agentic Live Bridge and file watcher for live AI typing and hot-reload
next_issue.body:
### Overview
Allow AI agents to stream and inject .debim manifests directly into IngeTrazo, and provide file hot-reloading.

### Tasks
1. Implement a local JSON-RPC / HTTP listener (`debim_ingetrazo/agent_bridge.py`) listening on `localhost:8482` allowing external AI agents to push raw .debim content to the active viewport.
2. Implement a background file watcher (`debim_ingetrazo/watcher.py`) that re-renders the viewport automatically when a target `.debim` file is saved.
3. Add an in-app interactive AI Console dialog to type/paste .debim text live.
next_issue.label: jules

next_issue.title: feat(spec): dual-mode parser for debim CLI schema and parametric Grid coordinate resolver
next_issue.body:
### Overview
Align `debim-ingetrazo` parser with official debim CLI specification (`schema: IFC4-Minimal`). Support both standard `elements: [{ class: Ifc... }]` and simplified mode.

### Tasks
1. Support reading `schema: "IFC4-Minimal"`, `grids: { axes_x, axes_y }`, and `elements: [...]` in `parser.py` and `builder.py`.
2. Implement parametric grid coordinate resolver:
   - Resolve grid intersections: `placement: { grid: ["1", "A"] }` -> coordinates `(x, y)`.
   - Resolve linear members: `from_grid: ["1", "A"], to_grid: ["2", "A"]` -> `start`, `end`.
   - Evaluate grid arithmetic offset expressions (e.g. `["GX_1 + 0.10", "GY_1 - 0.10"]`).
3. Render 2D/3D Grid line axes and text balloons in IngeTrazo viewport.
4. Add unit tests in `tests/test_parser.py` and `tests/test_builder.py` covering debim CLI `playground.debim.yaml`.
next_issue.label: jules

next_issue.title: feat(geometry): dedicated IfcFooting and IfcRoof (Gable, Hip, Shed, Flat) 3D mesh generation
next_issue.body:
### Overview
Implement first-class structural footings and architectural roof geometries in `builder.py` and `plugin.py`.

### Tasks
1. Create `Footing(GeometryObject)` class:
   - Support isolated spread footings (`shape: BOX`) and pile caps.
   - Support auto-placement under column bases or explicit placement.
2. Create `Roof(GeometryObject)` class:
   - Gable (หลังคาจั่ว), Hip (หลังคาปั้นหยา), Shed (เพิงหมาแหงน), and Flat (ดาดฟ้า).
   - Compute sloping 3D quad/triangle faces with overhang (eaves) and pitch angles.
3. Implement `_build_footing_faces()` and `_build_roof_faces()` in `plugin.py`.
4. Add test cases in `tests/test_builder.py` and `tests/test_plugin.py`.
next_issue.label: jules

next_issue.title: feat(geometry): architectural IfcStair, IfcSpace zones, and parametric IfcDoor/IfcWindow components
next_issue.body:
### Overview
Implement architectural spaces, stairs, and detailed door/window components in `debim-ingetrazo`.

### Tasks
1. Create `Stair(GeometryObject)`:
   - Generate parametric steps (risers, treads, and landing plates).
2. Create `Space(GeometryObject)`:
   - Calculate room net floor area ($m^2$) and air volume ($m^3$).
   - Render translucent 3D spatial boundary volumes in IngeTrazo.
3. Create `Door` and `Window` component entities with 3D frames and glazed panels.
4. Add unit and visual tests.
next_issue.label: jules
